title: Why pay agents to rebuild battle-tested software?

sections.text: Why are we paying AI agents to rebuild software that's already battle-tested, secure, scalable and flexible?
If you're maintaining an established site, or building a new one, you're probably wondering how to use AI efficiently. And here's the thing: starting from scratch isn't the answer.
sections.callout: Starting from scratch isn't the answer

sections.text: Agentic tools promise instant builds. But when it's time to scale and secure a real production app, that's where they often fall apart.

So instead of regenerating everything, content types, user management, taxonomies, e-commerce, you name it, build on a flexible open-source platform that already has it, and remove what you don't need.
Popular open source already provides the components agents need. Add the right infrastructure and hosting, and you've got a powerful, cost-effective toolkit.
sections.callout: 20+ years of collective intelligence. Still going.

sections.text: Now, you could use a SaaS like Contentful or Shopify. The power is there, but not the ultimate flexibility. You could use WordPress as it is, but maybe the admin isn't what you want, or some of the agentic pieces are missing. But combine the WordPress core APIs with the right AI platform and the right hosting, and you end up with what I believe is one of the most powerful, flexible, scalable and secure combos out there.
Decouple your frontend, your admin and your backend, or keep them together. Run it locally or in the cloud. No closed SaaS lock-in, and it's still scalable, secure and reliable.

sections.callout: Fun test: rebuild it with Proven Lab
sections.text: Here's a fun test. If you've already built an app or a site with an agent, ask it to rebuild it with Proven Lab. You might be surprised. It flips the script on everyone rebuilding their WordPress sites somewhere else because it looks cooler, until they get burnt.
Give agents the right framework and documentation, and they're excellent at building on existing APIs.
sections.callout: Agents excel at building on existing APIs

sections.text: Right now, a lot of people say the golden path is to ride the AI hype and rebuild everything from scratch. Proven Lab is here to test another direction, and to prove otherwise.

sections.callout: By pros, for pros. Open to anyone.
sections.text: Think of it as a lab. A playground built by professionals, for professionals, and open to anyone curious enough to try. Because you don't need to replatform or start from scratch to get professional, scalable apps ready for your business.
So come play. Try the rebuild test at proven-lab.com, and tell me what you find.
